newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha ends higher on crude, U.S.-bound cargo.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha ends higher on crude, U.S.-bound cargo.

text.p: NWE naphtha prices ended slightly higher after crude oil rebounded and talk still focused on a Skikda cargo heading for the U.S. Gulf Coast, traders said.
The clean tanker Bona Fortuna was fixed by Nova for loading February 2 out of Skikda for the U.S., according to shipping sources.
Naphtha traders said the 57,000 tonne cargo was sold by a Spanish end-user and was underpinning prices in the Med, where cargoes were notionally assessed at $216/$218 cif.
Feb swaps ended $1.50 higher at $219.50/$220.50 a tonne while March gained 75 cents to $213.50/$214.50.
Northwest Europe dealings were quiet, with high freight rates and lacklustre end-user demand limiting deals.
